defects.rationale: Condition `len(queue) >= 0` is always true, so the loop never terminates normally; it only exits via an IndexError from pop on an empty list.
The guard should be `len(queue) > 0` (or `while queue`); the `>= 0` boundary causes one extra iteration past exhaustion.
